summary: Auth integration testing complete. Backend: all 12 pytest tests PASSED (register/duplicate, login/wrong-password, /me with/without JWT, logout, emergent invalid session, seeded alex+test1). Frontend: all 10 critical flows PASSED — Welcome load, Welcome->Login navigation, invalid login shows login-error inline (does not proceed), valid login with seeded creds lands on Home (skipping onboarding), persistent session across page reload (expo-secure-store), Signup happy path Welcome->onboarding->signup->connect->paywall->Home, duplicate signup shows 'Email already registered' via signup-error and stays on Signup, More->Settings->settings-logout returns to Welcome, reload after logout does NOT auto-login, Dark mode regression works. Minor: Settings screen in Dark mode has low-contrast section titles (settingsH3/settingsSub don't get theme override) — 'Your Experience', 'Appearance', 'Budget Alerts', 'Enable alerts' labels barely visible on dark cards.

ui_bugs.issue: Section titles/subtitles (settingsH3, settingsSub styles) do not receive dark-theme text color; labels 'Your Experience', 'Appearance', 'Budget Alerts', 'Enable alerts' are nearly invisible on dark cards. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx lines 745-762.

issues: Low-contrast section titles/subtitles due to missing t.textInk/t.textMuted overrides on s.settingsH3 / s.settingsSub Text components.

action_items: Optional polish: apply t.textInk / t.textMuted to <Text style={s.settingsH3}> and <Text style={s.settingsSub}> inside SettingsScreen so section headings remain legible in Dark mode.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth flow implementation is clean: passlib bcrypt for password hashing, python-jose HS256 JWT with 7-day expiry, TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at for automatic cleanup, unique index on users.email, /_id excluded from all Mongo reads via projection.
get_current_user correctly accepts BOTH locally-issued JWT and Emergent session_token via _resolve_by_jwt || _resolve_by_google_session — matches the credentials doc.
AuthContext restores session on mount by calling /api/auth/me and clears secure-store token on failure — correct behavior.
index.tsx effect at line 937-940 auto-advances stage to 'app' only when user is on 'login' or 'welcome' — correctly preserves signup's cosmetic connect/paywall screens.
Minor: index.tsx is ~1400+ lines — consider splitting screens into separate files (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Test created a fresh user per run (email test_<uuid>@jaleter.app) for register/login/duplicate assertions. Seeded user alex+test1@jaleter.app is present and login-verified. No cleanup needed (unique emails per run).
